item: 3d. IND TEECL Wind Project 2 (Tamil Nadu placeholder)
note_zh: Techno Electric（子公司 Simran Wind Project）在坦米爾納德邦的風場分在不同縣：IFC 2011 年揭露的 126.9 MW 擴建在 Muthianpatti（蒂魯布爾縣 Dharapuram 區）、Amdhapuram 與 Rasta，在地文件放在蒂魯布爾縣與蒂魯內爾維利縣的村公所；2015 年又出售 44.45 MW。沒有單一地點可用，現有座標（10.68 N、78.40 E，蒂魯奇拉帕利附近）不在這些地方。
note_en: Techno Electric’s Tamil Nadu wind (through Simran Wind Project) is spread over several districts: the 126.9 MW expansion disclosed by IFC in 2011 is at Muthianpatti (Dharapuram taluk, Tiruppur), Amdhapuram and Rasta, with local documents at village offices in Tiruppur and Tirunelveli districts; 44.45 MW was sold in 2015. There is no single locality, and the current point (10.68 N, 78.40 E, near Tiruchirappalli) is at none of them.
why: A multi-site record; a single approximate point would mislead. Which units remain in the 111 MW record after the 2015 sale is unknown (Techno annual reports not reached).

note_zh: GEM 只寫「Dangri, Rajasthan」，座標（26.38 N、76.70 E）落在拉賈斯坦東部，與賈沙梅爾縣 Fatehgarh 區的 Dangri 風區（其他 Dangri 風場約 26.55 N、71.38 E）相距約 530 km，應是地名誤配。Leap Green 2017 年收購 Inox Renewables 與 Inox Renewables (Jaisalmer) 在拉賈斯坦等四邦的風場，可能就是本筆來源；但沒有出處直接寫 Leap 的 Dangri 風場在賈沙梅爾，也可能與「Dangri (GFL)」（54 MW，GFL 是 Inox Renewables 的母公司）重複，未查證。
note_en: GEM only says “Dangri, Rajasthan”; its point (26.38 N, 76.70 E) is in eastern Rajasthan, about 530 km from the Dangri wind area in Fatehgarh tehsil, Jaisalmer (other Dangri farms at about 26.55 N, 71.38 E), so it looks like a mis-geocoded place name. Leap Green bought the wind plants of Inox Renewables and Inox Renewables (Jaisalmer) in Rajasthan and three other states in 2017, which may be where this record comes from; but no source says Leap’s Dangri farm is in Jaisalmer, and it may also overlap “Dangri (GFL)” (54 MW; GFL is Inox Renewables’ parent) — not checked.
why: leapgreenenergy.com pages 502 / no project list; thewindpower’s free pages hide operators (“ND”); GlobalData’s “Dangri Wind Farm II – LGE” (64 MW, Inox 32 × 2 MW, March 2013) gives only “Rajasthan”. A relocation needs a source naming Leap’s site.

The Qiman 1,000 MW wind-storage project TBEA announced in June 2024 has no record of construction', 'https://baijiahao.baidu.com/s?id=1820129249520114866&wfr=spider&for=pc', rename='Xinjiang Ruoqiang River (TBEA) wind farm', zhname='特变电工若羌县若羌河100万千瓦风电及配套储能项目', note=True),
note_zh: GEM 把兩個項目混在一起：記錄名是「祁曼」，但別名、一期 750 MW「營運中」的出處都是若羌河 100 萬瓩項目（羅布莊風區，2024-12-31 首台併網）。祁曼 1,000 MW（一期 200、二期 800 MW，2024-06 公告）查無開工或併網報導。若羌河項目何時全容量併網、750 MW 是否已運轉都查不到；座標（38.374 N、89.96 E）在祁曼一帶而非羅布莊風區，羅布莊風區沒有可引用的座標。
note_en: GEM mixes two projects: the record is named “Qiman”, but its other name and the source for phase 1 (750 MW operating) are the Ruoqiang River 1 GW project (Luobuzhuang wind area, first turbine on the grid on 31 Dec 2024). The Qiman 1,000 MW project (200 + 800 MW, announced June 2024) has no construction or connection report. When Ruoqiang River reached full connection, and whether 750 MW runs, is not found; the point (38.374 N, 89.96 E) is in the Qiman area, not Luobuzhuang, and no citable Luobuzhuang coordinates were found.
why: Tried: TBEA’s Q1 2025 generation notice (cninfo, provincial totals only), the NEA page GEM cites (no mention), the Xinjiang 750 kV EIA PDF (404), searches for 全容量并网. A rename would also need the “· 2” phase record (250 MW construction, owner TBEA Xinjiang Sunoasis, refs from 2023–24 that fit the Ruoqiang River start in Oct 2023).

item: 6. CHN Envision Ejin Horo: Ordos Zero Carbon Park (440 MW) vs Yijinhuoluo Smart Energy (200 MW)

note_zh: 兩筆都是遠景在伊金霍洛旗的項目：智慧綜合能源 200 MW 風電示範項目列在內蒙古 2021 年保障性併網名單（遠景、20 萬瓩、儲能 30%/2h）；零碳產業園 500 MW 風光儲項目含風電 440 MW。查不到 200 MW 項目是否就是 440 MW 的一部分，也查不到各自的併網日期，不能判定重複。
note_en: Both are Envision projects in Ejin Horo Banner: the Smart Energy 200 MW wind demonstration project is on Inner Mongolia’s 2021 guaranteed-grid list (Envision, 200 MW, storage 30%/2h); the Zero-Carbon Park 500 MW wind-solar-storage project includes 440 MW of wind. Whether the 200 MW became part of the 440 MW, and either project’s connection date, are not found, so no duplicate can be shown.
why: kjt.nmg.gov.cn / ordos.gov.cn blocked in round 18; no approval document for the zero-carbon park’s wind found. Points differ (39.70 N 109.54 E vs 39.24 N 109.83 E, ~55 km apart).

item: 10. MEX Amistad (200 MW, no year) and Amistad II–IV
note_zh: Amistad 一期 200 MW 2017 年 3 月開工（Enel）、原定 2018 年 10 月交付，仍查不到實際商轉日期。Amistad II、III、IV（合計 350 MW）2022 年 7 月報導「已可運轉，但因能源管制委員會（CRE）不發發電許可停擺兩年」；本站資料目前只有 Amistad 一筆（GEM 的 II–IV 標為暫停，未進風場層），不需修改。
note_en: Amistad phase 1 (200 MW) started construction in March 2017 (Enel) with delivery planned for Oct 2018; the actual commercial-operation date is still not found. Amistad II, III and IV (350 MW together) were reported in July 2022 as “ready to operate but stopped for two years for lack of CRE generation permits”; the layer has only the one Amistad record (GEM’s II–IV are mothballed and not in the layer), so nothing to change there.
why: proyectosmexico.gob.mx fails TLS verification here (incomplete certificate chain), so its project sheets (Amistad II start 30 Jun 2019, III 26 Feb 2025, IV 31 Dec 2028 per search results) cannot be quoted; Enel annual reports not reached. The 188.1 MW (57 × G132) vs 200 MW question also remains (The Wind Power only).
